an1.333:1.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave appamattakaṃ imasmiṃ Jambudīpe ārāmarāmaṇeyyakaṃ vanarāmaṇeyyakaṃ bhūmirāmaṇeyyakaṃ pokkharaṇīrāmaṇeyyakaṃ,
an1.333:1.2: atha kho etad eva bahutaraṃ yadidaṃ ukkūla-vikūlaṃ nadī-viduggaṃ khāṇukaṇṭakādhānaṃ pabbata-visamaṃ: evam
an1.333:1.3: eva kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye thalajā, atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye odakā: evam eva
an1.334:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye manussesu paccājāyanti,
an1.334:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye aññatra manussehi paccājāyanti: evam eva
an1.335:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye majjhimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti,
an1.335:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye paccantimesu janapadesu paccājāyanti aviññātāresu milakkhesu: evam eva
an1.336:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye paññavanto ajaḷā aneḷamūgā paṭibalā subhāsita-dubbhāsitassa attham aññātuṃ,
an1.336:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye duppaññā jaḷā eḷamūgā na paṭibalā subhāsita-dubbhāsitassa atthaṃ aññātuṃ: evam eva
an1.337:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye ariyena paññācakkhunā samannāgatā,
an1.337:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye avijjāgatā sammūḷhā: evam eva
an1.338:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye labhanti Tathāgataṃ dassanāya,
an1.338:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye na labhanti Tathāgataṃ dassanāya: evam eva
an1.339:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye labhanti Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya,
an1.339:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye na labhanti Tathāgatappaveditaṃ dhammavinayaṃ savanāya: evam eva
an1.340:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye sutvā dhammaṃ dhārenti,
an1.340:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye sutvā dhammaṃ na dhārenti: evam eva
an1.341:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ upaparikkhanti,
an1.341:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye dhatānaṃ dhammānaṃ atthaṃ na upaparikkhanti: evam eva
an1.342:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye atthaṃ aññāya dhammam aññāya dhammānudhammaṃ paṭipajjanti,
an1.342:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye na atthaṃ aññāya na dhammaṃ aññāya dhammānudhammaṃ na paṭipajjanti: evam eva
an1.343:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu saṃvijjanti,
an1.343:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye saṃvejanīyesu ṭhānesu na saṃvijjanti: evam eva
an1.344:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye saṃviggā yoniso padahanti,
an1.344:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye saṃviggā yoniso na padahanti: evam eva
an1.345:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye vavassaggārammaṇaṃ karitvā labhanti samādhiṃ labhanti cittass' ekaggataṃ,
an1.345:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye vavassaggārammaṇam karitvā na labhanti samādhiṃ na labhanti cittass' ekaggataṃ: evam eva
an1.346:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye annaggarasaggānaṃ lābhino,
an1.346:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye annagga-rasaggānaṃ na lābhino uñchena kapālābhatena yāpenti: evam eva
an1.347:1.1: kho bhikkhave appakā te sattā ye attha-rasassa dhamma-rasassa vimutti-rasassa lābhino,
an1.347:1.2: atha kho ete va sattā bahutarā ye attharasassa dhammarasassa vimuttirasassa na lābhino.
an1.347:1.5: Evam hi vo bhikkhave sikkhitabban ti. 2.
